claims.statement: The bounded low-cover family check is correct: among the specified sorted positive branch profiles for n=2p+4 and p=10..13, exactly one profile is eligible, at p=10 with (2,3,3,3,3,3); its 17 favorable pendant leaves give separate tagged summands totaling -122805.
claims.scope: Only the root with c centers, 1<=c<=6, each with at least one pendant leaf, sorted branch sizes summing to 2p+3-c, for p=10..13. This does not cover all trees of vertex-cover number at most six or establish a universal shell or aggregate claim.
claims.reason: retained: exact family enumeration and an independent root-conditioned polynomial derivation agree on candidate counts, eligibility, the first strict descent and terminal zero-extension, all original leaves and strict selector values in the sole eligible witness, each same-support tagged summand, and the full negative sum. The source's generic selector loop omits the root leaf for c=1, but that candidate is ineligible and this omission does not affect the claimed eligible witness or eligibility totals. The bounded result has no bearing on the omitted general low-cover shapes or universal target.

limitations: The exhaustive boundary is the listed root-and-pendant-arms family only, not all ordinary trees of vertex-cover number at most six.
The sole eligible example has a negative full aggregate and does not settle the universal lower-region aggregate or shell-sign questions.
The route script omits the root from its selector loop for c=1; this candidate is ineligible and does not alter the reviewed claim.
